description: This pie chart visually represents the distribution of two categories related to the performance or components of the Paper Copilot system, as described in the paper. The chart is divided into two distinct slices: a large orange slice labeled "Reduction" which accounts for 69.92% of the total, and a smaller blue slice labeled "Efficient deployment" which accounts for 30.08%. The "Reduction" slice is the dominant portion, occupying nearly two-thirds of the pie, while the "Efficient deployment" slice is visibly smaller, making up just over one-third. Both categories are clearly labeled with their respective percentages directly within their corresponding slices, and the chart does not include a separate legend. The "Efficient deployment" slice is slightly offset or exploded from the rest of the pie, drawing attention to it as a distinct component. The slices are arranged in a descending order of size, with the larger "Reduction" slice positioned at the bottom left and the smaller "Efficient deployment" slice at the top right.
